what: Why copy modes need the same R x.y series
title: Getting Started with courieR
text: package’s compiled code (.dll/.files libs/) built specific R minor version’s binary interface. Packages compiled R 4.5.x reliably load R 4.6 — must rebuilt. : Within series (e.g. 4.5.0 ↔︎ 4.5.2) copying binary-safe, offline/preserve fast choice. Across minor versions (e.g. 4.5 → 4.6) compiled packages must reinstalled, online safe. dashboard hides copy modes pairs automatically. Pure-R packages (libs/) version-independent, online copies directly even across versions rebuilds compiled minority.
code: # explicit mode ship(source_path = old_r, target_path = new_r, mode = "offline")

title: Getting Started with courieR
text: shortest path uses migrate(), looks installations version string don’t need handle paths : control — filtering package, custom paths, progress callbacks — use ship() directly:
code: library(courieR)  # dry run first migrate("4.5.2", "4.6.0", dry_run = TRUE)  # for real result <- migrate("4.5.2", "4.6.0") table(result$results$status) routes  <- find_routes() old_r   <- routes$rscript_path[!routes$is_current][1] new_r   <- routes$rscript_path[routes$is_current]  result <- ship(source_path = old_r, target_path = new_r, upgrade = TRUE)

title: Getting Started with courieR
text: ship() always moves packages one way, source_path target_path. bring two -version installations line , run twice, swapping roles:
code: r_a <- routes$rscript_path[1] r_b <- routes$rscript_path[2]  # push everything A has into B ship(source_path = r_a, target_path = r_b, upgrade = TRUE)  # then push everything B has into A ship(source_path = r_b, target_path = r_a, upgrade = TRUE)

title: Detect R installations on the system — find_routes
text: Detection sources platform: Windows HKLM registry (SOFTWARE\R-core\R) - standard admin installs via CRAN Windows installer. HKCU registry (SOFTWARE\R-core\R) - non-admin installs register current user hive . %ProgramFiles%\R - directory scan admin installs registry. %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\R - rig-managed user-local installs. %USERPROFILE%\Documents\R - installs placed user's Documents folder. rig (rig list) - additional versions managed rig found path scanning. macOS /Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions - system-wide CRAN installer. ~/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions - user-local framework installs (admin required). Homebrew: /opt/homebrew/opt/r (Apple Silicon) /usr/local/opt/r (Intel). rig (rig list) - rig-managed versions. Linux /opt/R - rig system-wide installs. ~/.local/share/rig/R - rig user-local installs. conda environments (active $CONDA_PREFIX). System Rscript $PATH. Symlinks resolved via fs::path_real() duplicate entries different detection sources pointing executable collapsed. candidate probed short subprocess. probe timeout defaults 30 seconds can adjusted via options(courier.probe_timeout = ); installations whose probe times skipped warning rather silently dropped.

title: Ship packages between R installations — ship
text: source_path Full path Rscript executable source installation (one copying packages ). Use find_routes() discover available paths. target_path Full path Rscript executable target installation (one installing packages ). target R must pak installed mode = "online" pak fallbacks. packages Character vector package names act . NULL (default), packages missing outdated target included. dry_run TRUE, build return installation plan without installing anything. Use review happen committing sync. upgrade Passed pak::pkg_install() online mode. packages plan (missing outdated target) always installed latest compatible version regardless. TRUE, pak additionally upgrades every outdated dependency packages target library; FALSE (default), dependencies changed version requirement forces , much faster. log_callback Optional function one argument. provided, called single character string progress message emitted package transfer. mode Transfer mode: "online" reinstalls via pak (default), "offline" copies package directories file skips packages without valid source path, "preserve" copies first falls back pinned pak spec packages copied. source_pkgs, target_pkgs Optional pre-scanned manifests (returned manifest()) source target installations. supplied, corresponding manifest() subprocess scan skipped, avoiding redundant library scans caller already scanned installations. ... Reserved future arguments.

title: courieR 0.3.1
text: Fixed second cause shipped packages never showing installed, copy path (offline/preserve modes online mode’s local/private packages). manifest’s libpath library directory shared every package, .copy_plan() passed per-package source, “copy” recursively cloned entire source library target/<pkg>/ — leaving valid package R looks reporting silent success. package name now joined onto library path, also restores cross-major compiled-package warning (libs/ check always false ). Covered .copy_plan + copy_packages regression test opt-browser end--end test (COURIER_E2E=true). R installation detection longer drops installs intermittently slow machines. find_routes() probed candidate hard 3 s timeout silently discarded exceeded , cold R start (antivirus, OneDrive-synced installs) made versions flicker runs. default probe timeout now 30 s, configurable via options(courier.probe_timeout = ), probe time reported warning instead vanishing; rig list timeout also raised 5 s 15 s. Fixed shipped packages never showing installed: find_target_lib() pak install subprocess inherited parent R session’s R_LIBS_USER, ship() installed parent’s library Compare scanned real target. subprocesses launch another R now share one environment-stripping helper (child_r_env()), install destination guaranteed library manifest() scans. Library scans time longer cached “empty library” rest session; timeouts reported loudly log scan timeout raised 30 s 5 min slow machines. “installations share one library” warning longer fires vacuously scans returned packages.

title: courieR 0.3.1
text: Online mode now means online: every package resolvable CRAN / Bioconductor / GitHub reinstalled via pak (binaries preferred). local/private packages online source copied source library. (Previously pure-R CRAN packages file-copied even online mode, much slower pak synced/network libraries.)

title: courieR 0.3.1
text: One manifest scan per library per session, shared across tabs: ship right Compare reuses Compare scans spawns scan subprocesses; post-ship refresh rescans shipped-library.

title: courieR 0.3.1
text: Bulk Dispatch now shows live hero panel shipping (matching Custom Dispatch): packages delivered far, current package installed, elapsed time, estimated total. detailed log R console also mirrored dashboard log pane. Bulk Dispatch Custom Dispatch tables now default showing packages missing target Compare, instead diff statuses. filter chip bar lets toggle statuses. Custom Dispatch filter chips now colour-coded — orange source-side differences (newer source, target), teal target-side differences — matching Bulk Dispatch. Custom Dispatch comparison table gains Repo column showing package comes (CRAN, Bioconductor, GitHub, etc.). Packages unknown source shown red tables. report_issue() — new exported function. Call console error open pre-filled GitHub issue form browser R version, platform, courieR version, error message already populated. dashboard’s error modal gains Send Report button one click. Custom Dispatch shows live green hero panel shipping: packages delivered far, package currently copied/installed, elapsed time, estimated total. Time estimates (plan summary, ship confirmation, preview invoice) now come per-machine calibrated rates persisted across sessions — every completed ship updates — instead fixed constants 100x synced/network drives. Custom Dispatch source/target header now shows R version, install location, library path installations (bare executable path). Custom Dispatch shipment comparison tables refresh automatically depot log says ; refresh logged completes. library(courieR) startup message now includes link user guide vignette (vignette("get-started", package = "courieR")).

title: courieR 0.3.0
text: Flattened dashboard navigation three nested tab levels single row five top-level tabs: Bulk Dispatch, Browse, Custom Dispatch, Manifest, Maintenance. former Advanced wrapper tab gone. Renamed Dispatch → Bulk Dispatch, former Ship sub-tab now top-level Custom Dispatch tab. Custom Dispatch now uses two-pane layout — package table left live log panel (delivery receipt) right — mirroring Bulk Dispatch. comparison columns labelled Source / Target (Version / Version B), filter chips read “newer source / newer target / target / source”, redundant → B context bar removed.

title: courieR 0.3.0
text: Shipping longer upgrades entire dependency tree selected package: dashboard now calls ship() upgrade = FALSE. Selected packages still install upgrade latest compatible version, already-installed dependencies left alone unless version requirement forces change. removes main cause multi-minute single-package shipments. Custom Dispatch now scans library per Ship click passes scans ship() (source_pkgs/target_pkgs), instead re-scanning libraries every batch.

title: courieR 0.3.0
text: manifest() longer leaks parent R session’s library/home environment target R subprocess. Previously processx inherited R_LIBS_USER (R_HOME) R running courieR, every probed installation reported parent’s library — making distinct R versions appear share one library compare 100% identical. subprocess now strips R_LIBS_USER, R_LIBS, R_LIBS_SITE, R_HOME still reading target R’s .Renviron/.Rprofile. Dashboard: fixed “Operation allowed without active reactive context” startup, caused reading reactiveVal outside reactive consumer sync log helper (now wrapped isolate()).

title: courieR 0.3.0
text: Renamed core actions match courieR’s shipping vocabulary: Scout (detect installations), Inventory (compare libraries), Ship (transfer packages). main tab now Dispatch, Advanced tabs Restock, Depot, Delivery Receipt, Route, Manifest. Detection longer automatic startup; click Scout scan. Scout → Inventory → Ship workflow note appears control panel, result shared across tabs. logo twinkles app busy (tied Shiny’s busy/idle events). Comparison table: per-column filters (search boxes package/versions, dropdown status), pagination grouped compactly table, global search box removed. log panel sits beside comparison, spanning full height. Transfer mode options shortened (Online reinstall / Offline copy / Preserve version) live description selected mode. find_routes() called per scan shared across modules instead re-run , reducing startup/detection time.

title: courieR 0.2.3
text: "online" (default) — reinstall packages via pak CRAN/GitHub/Bioconductor. "offline" — copy package directories file; packages valid source path skipped reported. "preserve" — copy first keep exact versions; fall back pinned pak spec (pkg@version) packages copied. dashboard Sync tab exposes three options dropdown. migrate(, ) — one-call CLI migration. Pass version strings ("4.5.2", "4.6.0") full Rscript paths; courieR resolves installations runs ship() automatically. hub() — short alias open_hub(). Run hub() launch dashboard less typing. library(courieR) now prints version number reminder run hub() see ?ship. ship() gains log_callback argument real-time progress messages pak subprocess, including notice first-time metadata loading may take 1–2 minutes.

title: courieR 0.2.3
text: manifest() now reliably excludes base recommended packages Windows. previous path comparison case-sensitive let packages like translations slip sync plan, causing pak error. filter now uses case-insensitive path comparison name-based guard via installed.packages(priority = c("base", "recommended")).

title: courieR 0.2.3
text: find_routes() per-candidate subprocess timeout reduced 5 s 3 s, shortening detection time multiple R versions installed. Sync dashboard: replaced floating withProgress() modal inline Bootstrap progress bar inside log pane. Log lines now append DOM immediately, removing need shiny:::flushReact(). Sync dashboard: detection phase shows Bootstrap info alert scanning records “Detection complete: found N installation(s).” sync log.

title: courieR 0.2.0
text: CRAN release: 2026-05-30 CRAN readiness: hardened documentation, CRAN-safe examples, CI workflow. ship() gains @section Safety: block documenting subprocess library write behavior. manifest() now uses deparse() library path quoting, fixing edge cases special characters. manifest() CSV fallback parsing now handles multi-line CSV output correctly. Added cran-comments.md .github/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml. DESCRIPTION title simplified; version bumped.

title: courieR 0.1.0
text: Initial release. find_routes() detects R installations Windows, macOS, Linux, including user-local installs. manifest() scans installed packages R installation via subprocess. inventory() compares two package libraries reports missing, outdated, newer packages. ship() migrates packages one R installation another using pak. open_hub() launches Shiny dashboard point--click migration.
